mapper.sql: d.id, d.trade_order_id tradeOrderId, d.runner_user_id runnerUserId, d.pick_address pickAddress, d.receive_address receiveAddress, d.delivery_fee deliveryFee, d.status, d.accept_time acceptTime, d.finish_time finishTime, d.create_time createTime, o.order_no orderNo, o.buyer_id buyerId, o.seller_id sellerId, p.title productTitle, p.images productImages, bu.nickname buyerNickname, su.nickname sellerNickname
from delivery_order d join trade_order o on d.trade_order_id = o.id left join product p on o.product_id = p.id left join user bu on o.buyer_id = bu.id left join user su on o.seller_id = su.id
mapper.select:
select
where d.status = 0 and o.status in (0, 1) order by d.delivery_fee desc, d.id asc

select
where d.runner_user_id = #{runnerUserId} order by d.id desc limit 100

select ifnull(sum(case when status = 3 then 1 else 0 end), 0) finishedCount, ifnull(sum(case when status = 3 then delivery_fee else 0 end), 0) totalFee, ifnull(sum(case when status in (1, 2) then 1 else 0 end), 0) ongoingCount from delivery_order where runner_user_id = #{runnerUserId}
